materials.title: Tech and Show Week, April 21st - 26th
materials.content:
SHOW WEEK   BEST WEEK! Lets do this thang.

Every student is expected to be at all tech rehearsals and shows this week. Please email me if you have an absolutely unavoidable schedule conflict.

These rehearsals will be longer, so feel free to bring snacks. Parents: if bring food to your children, please try to do so by 4:15 PM before we start warming up. We will provide pizza and snacks for the cast on Friday Night before students get into costume. Please reach out if you'd like to bring any extra goodies for the students! 

 

Tech Schedule 

Monday, 4/21

Calltime - 4:00 PM 

End time - 6:30 PM

 

OFF TUESDAY (campus testing day)

 

Wednesday, 4/23, Dress Rehearsal

Calltime - 4:00 PM 

End time - 6:00 PM

 

Thursday, 4/24, Final Dress

Calltime - 4:00 PM 

End time - 6:00 PM

 

Friday, 4/25 SHOW NIGHT !!!!!!!

Calltime: 4:00 PM for cast dinner 

Be in costume by 5:00 PM.

Show begins at 6 PM. 

 Students will be released once all cast costumes are put away.

 

Saturday, 5/26. SHOW NIGHT AGAIN !!!

Calltime: 5:00 PM. Please eat before you get to school.

Be in costume by 5:30 PM.

Show begins at 6 PM. 

Students will be released once all cast costumes are put away.

 

 

Please spread the word about this show! This production is a bit under an hour long and is full of Shakespeare easter eggs, dorky theatre references, and a stacked cast of performers. As always, we appreciate your support!
